source.label: Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, cover page
source.quote: As of October 31, 2026 , there were 154,423,421 shares of the registrant's common stock outstanding ( 162,030,348 on a fully diluted basis, including 7,606,927 Class B-2 common units of a consolidated subsidiary, BlackRock Saturn Subco, LLC, which are exchangeable on a one-for-one basis into common stock of the registrant).

notes: Common stock trades on the NYSE as BLK. The Subco Units are included because BlackRock's own cover page counts them in its fully diluted share count and they are exchangeable one-for-one into common stock; BlackRock's adjusted earnings per share also assumes all Subco Units are exchanged. Leaving them out would lower the share count by 4.7%. They are equity of a subsidiary (redeemable noncontrolling interest) rather than BlackRock common stock, so a common-stock-only market value would use the first class alone. BlackRock has no preferred stock outstanding.
